question: How is sound produced?
urdu_translation: sound کیسے produce ہوتی ہے؟

B: By vacuum alone / صرف vacuum سے
C: By vibrating objects / vibrating objects سے
D: By electric charge without motion / motion کے بغیر electric charge سے

question: Which part of a guitar produces sound directly?

B: Vibrating strings / vibrating strings

correct_answer: B | Vibrating strings / vibrating strings

C: Mechanical wave / mechanical wave

correct_answer: C | Mechanical wave / mechanical wave

question: Sound waves in air are:
urdu_translation: air میں sound waves کس nature کی ہیں؟

C: Successive compressions and rarefactions / successive compressions اور rarefactions

question: When air is reintroduced into the bell jar, the sound becomes audible again because:
urdu_translation: bell jar میں air واپس introduce کرنے پر sound audible کیوں ہوتی ہے؟

urdu_translation: air temperature increase ہونے سے sound speed پر generally کیا effect ہوتا ہے؟

question: Which medium listed has a greater sound speed than air?
urdu_translation: listed media میں air سے greater sound speed کس کی ہے؟

question: A higher-frequency sound has:

B: No pitch / no pitch
C: Higher pitch / higher pitch
D: The same pitch in all cases / تمام cases میں same pitch
correct_answer: C | Higher pitch / higher pitch

question: What does quality of sound allow us to distinguish?
urdu_translation: quality of sound ہمیں کیا distinguish کرنے دیتی ہے؟
A: Only loud and quiet sounds / صرف loud اور quiet sounds

correct_answer: A | Musical sound has regular controlled vibrations; noise is irregular and sudden / musical sound regular controlled vibrations جبکہ noise irregular اور sudden ہوتی ہے

question: What is an echo?

D: A direct sound without reflection / reflection کے بغیر direct sound
correct_answer: B | A reflected sound heard separately from the original sound / reflected sound جو original sound سے separately heard ہو

urdu_translation: distinct echo کے لیے minimum time gap کیا ہے؟
